assumptions_challenged: That SGL-001 already has a characterized source-cell MCB/WCB available for regulatory-use comparability studies.
That validated, fit-for-purpose intact-EV assays (with documented LLOQ, specificity, precision, accuracy) are in hand to permit lot-to-lot and cross-species comparisons.
That >=3 GMP-like production runs with full release and stability/potency reproducibility data exist or can be demonstrated within the proposed timeline without additional resources.

That rodent intranasal biodistribution data (as currently available to the program) are sufficient to support cross-species CNS exposure claims without orthogonal intact-EV analytics and controlled bridging studies.
That formulation/device compatibility with intact-EV recovery has been demonstrated ex vivo and in vivo with appropriate controls.
falsification_conditions: Program provides MCB/WCB master and working bank documentation showing identity testing, adventitious-agent testing, and stability characterization meeting regulatory expectations (and these documents are verifiable).

Program supplies validated intact-EV assay reports (SOPs and validation summaries) demonstrating LLOQ, specificity, precision, accuracy, and orthogonality for key QC attributes (particle count, protein/lipid markers, nucleic acid content).

Program submits records for >=3 GMP-like lots including in-process controls, full release test results, accelerated and real-time stability data, and demonstration of reproducible identity/purity/potency across lots.

A stability-indicating, mechanism-linked potency assay is developed and its results are shown to correlate with an in vivo PD endpoint (or an explicitly justified surrogate) in a blinded study with appropriate controls.
Formulation/device compatibility is demonstrated with intact-EV recovery measured ex vivo and confirmed in a pilot in vivo study including negative/vehicle and spike-recovery controls.

Regulatory-ready briefing package (pre-IND/scientific advice) assembled that cites the above program-specific evidence and receives no critical CMC deficiencies from at least one regulatory authority.
strongest_objection: The recommendation to proceed to comparability or cross-species bridging before receiving program-specific CMC/analytics/batch data rests on incomplete program evidence: the supplied corpus contains only the MISEV2023 guidance and no program MCB/WCB records, assay validation reports, GMP-like batch records, stability and potency correlation data, or formulation/device compatibility studies. Therefore the core advance (that comparability/bridging can be meaningfully assessed now) is unsupported until those program-specific data are delivered.
